revenue.label: 收入 / Revenue
revenue.definition: Reported revenue; segment scope is separate from consolidated scope.

operating_income.label: 营业利润 / Operating income
operating_income.definition: Reported operating income on the stated entity/basis.

capex_cash_payments.label: 固定资产现金支出 / PP&E cash payments
capex_cash_payments.definition: Positive cash payments for PP&E; not automatically equivalent to management CapEx.

remaining_performance_obligations.label: 剩余履约义务 / RPO
remaining_performance_obligations.definition: Reported remaining performance obligations; instant balance, not revenue.

capex_guidance.label: 资本开支指引 / CapEx guidance
capex_guidance.definition: Management CapEx range; repeated speakers are disclosures, not additive forecasts.

investment_rationale.label: 投资理由 / Investment rationale
investment_rationale.definition: Attributed management explanation, not established causation.

cloud_growth_outlook.label: Cloud 增长展望 / Cloud outlook
cloud_growth_outlook.definition: Qualitative future growth; unresolved target dates remain explicit.

infrastructure_expense_pressure.label: 基础设施费用压力 / Expense pressure
infrastructure_expense_pressure.definition: Attributed depreciation and operating expense pressure.

depreciation.label: 折旧实际值 / Actual depreciation
depreciation.definition: Historical reported depreciation; separate from future outlook.

depreciation_outlook.label: 折旧展望 / Depreciation outlook
depreciation_outlook.definition: Qualitative expected depreciation growth, not a forecast amount.

capex_machine_share.label: 机器投资比例 / Machine share
capex_machine_share.definition: Management description of historical investment composition.

capex_long_duration_share.label: 长期资产投资比例 / Long-duration share
capex_long_duration_share.definition: Data center and networking assets as a share of investment.

investment_mix_outlook.label: 投资构成展望 / Investment mix outlook
investment_mix_outlook.definition: Qualitative future similarity, without invented exact shares.

building_useful_life.label: 建筑使用寿命 / Building useful life
building_useful_life.definition: Modal possible life; does not describe every component or guarantee a minimum.

cloud_ml_compute_share.label: Cloud ML 算力比例 / Cloud ML compute share
cloud_ml_compute_share.definition: Share of ML compute allocated to Cloud, NOT share of total CapEx.

gross_profit.label: 毛利润 / Gross profit
gross_profit.definition: Known metric definition, but not extracted by this pilot.
